grades.quote: directory but xv6 will not delete the inode yet, because the reference count of the inode is still larger than zero.
grades.reason: Gives the key mechanism. After a name is unlinked, xv6 does not delete the inode while its reference count is above zero, because iget increments that count. A holder of the inode can therefore still use it. The passage is framed around path lookup races, not an open file descriptor, so it only partly answers the query.
